dog.description_text: Meet Mickey — New Arrival! Mickey just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQA6KulKkGhQS74j19yxF5bhAcL3E_Q6R1wF7tD9wg4GIlk?e=poFPRX His foster says "He was shy in the beginning. Had a hard time adjusting to the new environment. But he came out and started exploring the second day. He really laid back. Quiet, loves scratches, taking a nap. Overall he is adorable." He is relaxed and affectionate. He has been neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
